messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for The Beehive?
messages.body:
Hi,

Quick bump on Jake Essex for the Beehive. He's a proper 50s and 60s singer
(himself, not a tribute), own PA, no deposit, and he's from Essex, so not
far at all. He works really well for a busy Saturday night.

The fee is £300 cash for two one hour sets, or £250 a night if you book
four dates. If a Saturday in the months ahead could work, reply here and
I'll send free dates, or pass me to whoever books your entertainment.

If it's not for you, reply "no thanks" and I won't email again.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk
